name: OpEra
long_description: OpEra is the AI decision engine for factories, warehouses and fleets. Companies with physical operations make thousands of decisions every day, and we help their teams make the best one at every step from production to delivery: (1) Planning: how much to make, buy and stock. (2) Scheduling: what runs when, and who works on what. (3) Allocation: which warehouse or store gets each order. (4) Routing: boat, plane or truck, and which route each one takes. Founded out of MIT's Operations Research Center.
one_liner: The AI decision engine for factories, warehouses and fleets
